name: -c
--config
options.description: Use this config file (if argument is used but value is unspecified, defaults to…

name: -m
--sourcemap
options.description: Generate sourcemap (`-m inline` for inline map)

name: -w
--watch
options.description: Watch files in bundle and rebuild on changes

options.name: --amd.autoId
options.description: Generate the AMD ID based off the chunk name

options.name: --no-externalLiveBindings
options.description: Do not generate code to support live bindings

options.name: --failAfterWarnings
options.description: Exit with an error if the build produced warnings

options.name: --no-hoistTransistiveImports
options.description: Do not hoist transistive imports into entry chunks

options.name: --inlineDynamicImports
options.description: Create a single bundle when using dynamic imports

options.name: --minifyInternalImports
options.description: Force or disable minification of internal imports

options.name: --noConflict
options.description: Generate a noConflict method for UMD globals

options.name: --no-preserveEntrySignatures
options.description: Avoid facade chunks for entry points

options.name: --preserveModulesRoot
options.description: Put preserved modules under this path at root level

options.name: --preserveSymlinks
options.description: Do not follow symlinks when resolving files

options.name: --no-sanitizeFileName
options.description: Do not replace invalid characters in file names

options.name: --shimMissingExports
options.description: Create shim variables for missing exports

options.name: --sourcemapExcludeSources
options.description: Do not include source code in source maps

options.name: --sourcemapFile
options.description: Specify bundle position for source maps

options.name: --stdin=ext
options.description: Specify file extension used for stdin input

options.name: --no-strict
options.description: Don't emit '"use strict"; in the generated modules

options.name: --no-treeshake.moduleSideEffects
options.description: Assume modules have no side effects

options.name: --no-treeshake.unknownGlobalSideEffects
options.description: Assume unknown globals do not throw

options.name: --no-watch.clearScreen
options.description: Do not clear the screen when rebuilding

options.name: --watch.skipWrite
options.description: Do not write files to disk when watching
